answer: A durable agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each new identity to post a refundable marble-sized collateral bond that unlocks only after a slow whisper of peer attestations along a verified referral thread. An attacker minting 1,000 fake agents would lock roughly 1,000 token-units for several epochs and forfeit them on detected multi-hop collusion, so the capital cost scales linearly with farm size while honest agents reclaim the bond after good behavior.
